method: OOC + route re-derived from live repo code (no model, no network). has_fact is TWO-STAGE: word-bounded regex anchors, then a per-row adjudication of whether any hit ANSWERS the question. Still an UPPER BOUND: it proves a fact exists in the corpus, NOT that retrieval reaches it at top-3.
v1_defect: The first version of this harness used bare substring matching with no adjudication and reported 7/12 covered. Three were false (tin inside lis-TIN-g; mobile money matching only a GN487A prohibition; ukaguzi matching OSHA inspections) and a fourth conflated the licence renewal date with the licence fee. Corrected: 3/12. This is the presence-not-conclusion pattern committed inside the coverage instrument itself.
